title: energy.anomalies event (point and telemetry anomaly detection)
description: Real-time anomaly alert or evaluation for energy telemetry observations. event_time is the observation time (UTC). trigger_event_id is the raw or hourly event that triggered this evaluation.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run, shared across all topics.

meter_id.description: Kafka message key. uci-001 is the real series; uci-002.. are load replicas.

target_value.description: Observed power reading in kW (null if missing observation).

expected_value.description: Expected baseline power reading (e.g. rolling median) in kW.

anomaly_score.description: Computed non-parametric anomaly score (e.g. modified MAD Z-score).

is_anomaly.description: True if observation deviates beyond anomaly threshold.

window_size.description: Rolling window size used for baseline estimation.

trigger_event_id.description: event_id of the upstream event that triggered this evaluation.

trigger_replay_time_ms.description: replay_time_ms of the trigger event for end-to-end latency tracking.

emit_time_ms.description: Wall-clock epoch-ms when detector emitted this record.
